sections.title: Applications in Urban Design & Development
sections.description: This elective seminar will provide a deeper dive into issues of evidence-based, high-performance, urban development & design. The course is intended for MCP students, and anyone with an interest in the large scale urban design & development projects. Diverse problem-solvers, with any one of a variety of backgrounds, such as design, landscape architecture, and financial analysis are encouraged to enroll. This is a project-based course in which students will work in groups on a semester-long project. The topic is flexible.
